title: 第十章 银月龙王泽希塔
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

伊尔莎简直不敢相信，那位传说中的银月龙王就出现在了自己的面前，

还是以人类的形象。

作为魔族王女，伊尔莎很小时候就听闻过这位龙族之王的名号，对于她最深的印象还是五十年前魔族和龙族的虹秋之战中，泽希塔仅一龙就全歼了魔族一直以来战无不胜的嗜刃军，还杀死了当时的大皇子，嗜刃军的大元帅弗雷德。

而且那时候的泽希塔还是刚成为龙族之王，那次正是她的立威之战，就彻底声名远扬，

后来魔族放弃了西部扩张计划，很大的原因就是忌惮于她，甚至之后专门成立了个部门，用数十年时间去研究和破解泽希塔的魔法，可见这龙已经成为了魔族的一代阴影。

而这么一位实力恐怖又性格暴躁的龙，却被亚枫给激怒了，做出了这番光是想想就会万劫不复的事。

冷风拂面，伊尔莎此时心都跳到了嗓子眼，连遗言都想好了。

她僵硬的扭动脖子，看向一边的亚枫，心中正在强烈祈祷着，祈祷着他千万不要做出激怒泽希塔的事来，

亚枫看着上方的泽希塔，不知从哪里拿出了一朵蓝色的玫瑰，开口了：

“结婚一百八十天纪念日快乐，泽希塔。”他举起了蓝色玫瑰说道。

一道雷霆落下，瞬间将他手中的玫瑰劈成了焦炭，化作粉尘飘散，泽希塔居高临下，冰冷的眼中带着极强的杀意。

“你想死吗。”她冷冷开口。

完蛋了。

伊尔莎也绝望了。

亚枫拍了拍手上玫瑰的焦灰，叹了口气，嘀咕着：

“这玫瑰花了我五块钱呢...”

一道道蓝紫色的雷霆环绕着泽希塔的身周，噼啪作响。

“本王现在只给你十秒钟的时间，说出你的目的，如果和恢复龙身没有任何关系，本王现在就杀了你！”她厉声道。

“那确实没关系...”亚枫说道。

下一刻，万钧的雷霆聚集而起，马上就要朝他迎头劈来。

“但是——”

亚枫竖起一根手指，指向她。

“和你的冰冻症有关。”

汹涌的雷霆之光又瞬间熄灭了。

“你说什么？”泽希塔的目光凝聚起来。

“你的冰冻症，还有十来天就又要发作了吧？不过我有办法治愈你，现在有兴趣了吗？”

泽希塔朝他眯起了眼睛。

“你又想要耍什么花招？”

“心疼你而已，见不得你难受。”亚枫发自真心的说道。

泽希塔沉默少许，没有再发作，低低喝了一声：

“说。”

亚枫咳嗽了一声。

“你幼年在永夜之地试炼时意外被遗迹内的千年寒泉所侵蚀，留下隐疾，导致每年的弦月之秋，你的力量都会大幅度衰减，身上还会出现无法抑制的僵化，伴随着强烈的痛苦，且很难缓解，这种状态短则三五天，长则半个月，一直找不到治愈方法，只能硬熬过去，每次都会被折磨到元气大伤，没错吧？”

泽希塔不语，继续静静的注视着他。

“不过，有一样东西可以治愈你的冰冻症，就是来自千湖之岛的日光花。”

听到这里泽希塔嗤笑一声：“这种事本王早就知道了。”

但问题就是她找不到千湖之岛，因为千湖之岛一直以来都是魔族所掌管的秘境，坐标以及进入的秘术都是赫戈曼皇室的机密，

而她又正好和魔族有点小摩擦，上一任的魔族元帅，同时也是魔族大皇子的弗雷德里就是她杀的，想要让他们同意恐怕有点困难。

Page (1/3)

Ilsa couldn't believe that the legendary Silver Moon Dragon King appeared in front of her.

Still in human form.

As the princess of the Demon Clan, Ilsa had heard the name of the Dragon King when she was very young. The deepest impression on her was that during the Rainbow Autumn Battle between the Demon Clan and the Dragon Clan fifty years ago, Zexita completely annihilated the Demon Clan's invincible Blade-Hungry Army with just one dragon, and also killed the then eldest prince, the Blade-Hungry Army's Grand Marshal Fred.

And at that time, Zexita had just become the king of the dragon clan. It was the battle where she established her power, and she became famous far and wide.

Later, the demons gave up their western expansion plan. The main reason was that they were afraid of her. They even set up a department later to spend decades studying and deciphering Zexita's magic. It can be seen that this dragon has become a shadow of the demons.

But such a dragon with terrifying strength and bad temper was angered by Ya Feng and did something that would make him irreversible just thinking about it.

The cold wind blew across her face, and Ilsa's heart jumped into her throat at this moment, and she had even thought about her last words.

She twisted her neck stiffly and looked at Yafeng aside. She was praying fiercely in her heart, praying that he would never do anything to anger Zexita.

Yafeng looked at Zexita above, took out a blue rose from somewhere, and said:

"Happy 180th wedding anniversary, Zeshita," he said, holding up the blue rose.

A bolt of thunder fell, instantly chopping the rose in his hand into charcoal and turning into dust. Zexita stood condescendingly, with a strong murderous intent in his cold eyes.

"Do you want to die?" she said coldly.

It's over.

Ilsa was also desperate.

Yafeng patted the burnt ashes of the rose on his hand, sighed, and muttered:

"This rose cost me five yuan..."

Lines of blue-purple thunder surrounded Zexita's body, crackling.

"I will only give you ten seconds to tell you your purpose. If it has nothing to do with restoring the dragon body, I will kill you now!" She said sternly.

"That really doesn't matter..." Yafeng said.

The next moment, thousands of thunderbolts gathered together and were about to hit him head-on.

"But-"

Yafeng raised a finger and pointed at her.

"It has something to do with your freezing syndrome."

The raging light of thunder was extinguished instantly.

"What did you say?" Zexita's eyes focused.

"Your freezing syndrome will attack again in about ten days, right? But I have a way to cure you. Are you interested now?"

Zechita narrowed her eyes at him.

"What tricks do you want to play again?"

"I just feel sorry for you, I don't want to see you in pain." Ya Feng said sincerely.

Zexita was silent for a while and did not have another attack. She drank in a low voice:

"Say."

Yafeng coughed.

"When you were young, you were accidentally eroded by the thousand-year cold spring in the ruins during the trial in the Land of Eternal Night, leaving behind hidden diseases. As a result, your strength will be greatly weakened every year during the quarter-moon autumn, and you will also have uncontrollable rigidity on your body, accompanied by intense pain, which is difficult to relieve. This state can last from three to five days to as long as half a month. There is no cure, so you can only get through it. Every time, you will be tortured until your vitality is severely damaged, right?"

Zexita remained silent and continued to watch him quietly.

"However, there is one thing that can cure your freezing syndrome, and that is the sunflower from the Island of Thousand Lakes."

Hearing this, Zexita sneered: "I have known this for a long time."

But the problem is that she can't find the Island of Thousand Lakes, because the Island of Thousand Lakes has always been a secret realm controlled by the demons. The coordinates and the secret technique to enter are the secrets of the Hegeman royal family.

And she happened to have a little friction with the demons. It was her who killed the previous demon marshal and the demon's eldest prince, Fredry. It might be difficult to get them to agree.
